採用・広告の製品.quote: Metoro collects logs, metrics, traces, profiling, Kubernetes events, and deployment context from your cluster with eBPF.
Metoro's AI agents use that context to detect production issues, investigate alerts, verify deployments, identify root causes, and open fix PRs.

Metoro's collector runs as a DaemonSet on every node and captures the full telemetry stack at the kernel with no code changes, no SDKs, and no restarts. Every signal arrives pre-correlated with Kubernetes identity, so services, pods, and deploys already line up when the agent goes looking.
On-CPU flame graphs per process, always on. Spot hot paths and memory leaks without redeploying.
Every rollout tied to commit, author, PR, and the workloads it touched.
OpenTelemetry / Prometheus-compatible for anything eBPF can't see

The same data that powers your dashboards becomes context for an agent that watches production continuously - detecting regressions, investigating alerts, verifying deploys, and opening fix PRs for issues as they arise.
Metoro detects every change across your clusters. After a change is detected, Metoro analyzes the change (code or config) and verifies that production behavior is not impacted.
Metoro investigates each alert automatically, filters the noise, and returns root cause and next steps before on-call digs in so you can can wake up to answers, not problems.
Detection, investigation, and the fix PR - all before I finished reading the page. It's the first AI SRE that's actually earned its name.
